newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index little changed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index little changed in thin trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed slightly down in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 499.58 from 499.65 points last Friday.
Total volume was 591,354 dinars against 800,966 million dinars over the previous session.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF fell 0.69 dinar to 17.1 dinars. Coca and beer bottler SFBT slid 0.38 dinar to 91.02.
UIB bank edged lower 0.32 dinar to 12.4 dinars. BIAT bank declined 0.28 dinar to 37.2.
Airline Tunis Air was down 0.2 dinar to 24 dinars with 3,256 shares changing hands.
Banque de Tunisie won one dinar to 75 dinars. Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel gained 0.4 dinar to 13. Palm Beach Hotels was up 0.3 dinar to 11.3 dinars.
BTEI bank rose 0.2 dinar to 23. Detergent firm SPCD advanced 0.18 dinar to 36.8 dinars. ($1= 1.09 dinar)
